To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the SUSY QCD corrections to the bottom quark annihilation process are large and that the remnant effects in the Higgs boson sector may be observable in future high-energy hadron collider experiments.

the SUSY QCD corrections to the Higgs-boson associated production process pp(p (p (p) overbar)-->bh+ X, which is an important channel for probing the bottom Yukawa coupling and the SUSY remnant effects, are quite sizable in some SUSY parameter space, while they are negligible in the case of heavy SUSY particles.
the SUSY QCD corrections to Higgs-boson associated production via bg-->bh are quite large in some regions of the parameter space.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the Higgs-boson physics at hadron collid- ers in the presence of SUSY.
the SUSY QCD effects on the Higgs production process at the LHC and Tevatron.
the study of SUSY effects on the Higgs-boson bottom-quark associated production and their possible observability at the LHC and Tevatron.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the one-loop SUSY QCD corrections to the Higgs boson associated bottom quark production are quite sizable and should be included in the analysis.
the SUSY-QCD effects in the Higgs-boson sector may be observable at the LHC, even if the SUSY particles are not directly observable.
, although the SUSY corrections are not very important for the Higgs boson mass and couplings, they may be quite important for the H->b (b) over bar decay branching ratio.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the SUSY QCD corrections are important in the case of a light CP- odd Higgs boson, and the remnant effects are also important in the case that tan beta is large and the CP-odd HIGGS boson is relatively light.
SUSY corrections to Higgs production in association with a bottom quarks are important in the parameter region where the Higgs boson is light, the bottom quark is heavy, and tan beta is large.
, in the Higgs-boson physics at the Tevatron and LHC, SUSY QCD corrections may be very large and the remnant effects from the SUSY QCD may be observable.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SUSY effects on the Higgs-boson physics are quite significant and cannot be neglected in any serious study.
the Higgs boson associated with the bottom quark may be a useful channel in testing SUSY.
the SUSY QCD effects on the Higgs production process pp(p (p (p) over-bar))-->bh+X are quite significant and should be taken into account in the analysis of this process at the LHC.
